title: Role-play lab (2): hidden holdings, goal near, recent units
objectives: Answer the remaining three rebalancing conversations.
Measure the whole portfolio, spot glide-path cases, and check recent-unit costs.
body_md:
Hidden holdings: measure drift on the whole portfolio before deciding — Arun's total mix may already be near target. Goal near: explain this needs a new target along the glide path, not a rebalance; agree and record the new target. Recent SIP units: check exit load and short-term gains; use new money or wait where sensible; refer tax to a CA.

> **Investor takeaway:** Measure the whole portfolio, spot glide-path cases, and check recent-unit costs.
example: Arun: funds look 80% equity, but ₹30 L in PPF and FDs — measure the whole portfolio first.
say: Measure drift on the whole portfolio.
A goal 2 years away needs a new target, not a rebalance.
never: Rebalance to 60/40 when the goal is near.

check.q: Arun's funds look 80% equity, but he has ₹30 L in PPF and FDs. What do you do?
o: Measure drift on the whole portfolio; his total mix may already be near target
check.why: Measure drift on the whole portfolio; his total mix may already be near target.

check.q: Priya's goal is 2 years away and she asks to “rebalance to 60/40”. What do you explain?
o: This needs a new target along the glide path, not a rebalance; agree and record the new target
check.why: Explain this needs a new target along the glide path, not a rebalance; agree and record the new target.

check.q: A rebalance would redeem units bought 6 months ago. What do you check first?
o: Exit load and short-term gains; use new money or wait where sensible
check.why: Check exit load and short-term gains; use new money or wait where sensible; refer tax to a CA.
